items.title: Why Alphabet’s stock could see its worst drop in years after the latest results
items.description: A doubling of cloud revenue wasn’t enough to appease Wall Street as investors grew more concerned that AI is hurting the company’s ability to make money off search queries.

items.title: The major reason Microsoft’s stock is heading higher after earnings

items.title: Chipotle now has more demand from lower-income diners than higher-income ones

items.title: We stopped helping our neighbors with free home repairs and our friendship cooled. Who’s to blame?
items.description: “Last summer, they complained about needing to replace their roof. A few months later, they bought a new SUV.”

items.title: My wife cried when I found out she had only $80,000 in her 401(k). I have $2.2 million. Am I wrong to be shocked?
items.description: “When I brought up retiring last spring, she said she was ready whenever I was, and I took that to mean we were in good shape.”
